subject: Chemistry
scope: Two distinct original AQA AS TOF recall outcomes, accompanying three audited corrections to existing atomic-structure cards.
notes: No laboratory procedures. Existing source deck and card IDs are not replaced. TOF acceleration comparisons explicitly specify equal charge and energy.

cards.subject: Chemistry
cards.front: In electron-impact mass spectrometry, what knocks an electron out of a gaseous sample particle?
cards.back: A high-energy electron from the ionising electron beam.
accept: A high-energy electron from the ionising electron beam.
An electron from the electron beam.
reject: A positive ion from the drift region.

cards.subject: Chemistry
cards.front: What does the TOF detector's timing system record before the mass-to-charge ratio is calculated?
cards.back: The arrival time of each ion (its time of flight).
accept: The arrival time of each ion (its time of flight).
The time taken for the ion to arrive at the detector.
When the ion hits the detector.
reject: The ion's concentration in mol dm-3.
